title: If Letters Home Could Sing
subtitle: A biometric installation giving voice to Hainanese women
abstract: This research transforms historical qiao pi correspondence into an embodied encounter: heart rate-synchronised sound experiences that centre Hainanese women’s everyday voices and challenge monolithic narratives of the Chinese diaspora.

nodes.text: 1. Introduction: The Politics of Transnational Chinese Correspondence
2. New Museology and Embodied Experience Applied
Museums become spaces not just for preserving the past, but for creating living connections between cultural heritage and contemporary experience—one heartbeat at a time.
